fields.name: client
fields.description: The client address; behind a proxy this is the visitor's address only if real-IP is configured.
fields.if_missing: Already in the combined format. Behind a proxy, add the real-IP configuration so the field holds the visitor and not the proxy.

fields.name: user
fields.description: The authenticated user name, normally a dash on a public site.
fields.if_missing: Already in the combined format; nothing reads it.

fields.name: time
fields.description: The time the request arrived, in the server's local time with offset.

fields.name: request
fields.description: The request line: method, path and protocol.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The HTTP status the server sent.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: The size of the response body in bytes.

fields.name: referer
fields.description: The Referer header. The tools never keep it (DR-0002); the server's own log does.
fields.if_missing: Already in the combined format; nothing reads it.

fields.name: ua
fields.description: The User-Agent header, the first thing a cohort is built from.

fields.name: rt
fields.description: Total time to serve the request, in seconds (nginx) or microseconds (Apache %D).

apache.note: Apache reports microseconds, nginx seconds; the reader converts.

fields.name: urt
fields.description: Time the upstream took, the cost of a request; several values when nginx retried.

apache.note: Stock Apache has no upstream response time (to be verified); mark the field not_applicable or rely on rt.

fields.if_missing: Add to the log format. On Apache the field cannot be had; rank by rt instead.

fields.name: cf_ray
fields.description: Cloudflare's request identifier, the handle central IT needs to find one request.
fields.if_missing: Add to the log format. Evidence packs for Cloudflare requests cite this value.

fields.name: cf_country
fields.description: The country Cloudflare placed the client in.

fields.name: peer
fields.description: The address of the connection itself, which tells a proxy edge from a direct client.
fields.if_missing: Add to the log format; it needs the real-IP module configured.

fields.name: lang
fields.description: The Accept-Language header, one of the cohort fingerprint signals.

fields.name: ch_ua
fields.description: The Sec-CH-UA client hint, the browser brands the client claims.

fields.name: ch_plat
fields.description: The Sec-CH-UA-Platform client hint, the operating system the client claims.

fields.name: bot_score
fields.description: Cloudflare's bot score for the request, when the plan sends it.
fields.if_missing: Add to the log format, and ask central IT to enable the bot protection headers managed transform; without it the value is always a dash.

fields.name: ja3
fields.description: Cloudflare's JA3 TLS fingerprint hash, when the plan sends it.
fields.if_missing: Add to the log format, and ask central IT to enable the bot protection headers managed transform.

fields.name: ja4
fields.description: Cloudflare's JA4 TLS fingerprint, when the plan sends it.
fields.if_missing: Add to the log format, and ask central IT to enable the bot protection headers managed transform.
